name: initIsrcFormatting() never reformats a valid code
why: The core of org/ISRC.org item 3 — without this, every native ISRCs column keeps showing MusicBrainz's compact, un-hyphenated code forever.

name: a malformed ISRC is treated as valid (no invalid marker)
why: Org item 6 — without this, a code that doesn't match CC-XXX-YY-NNNNN gets neither the ⚠️ glyph nor a filterable invalid count, and a real data-entry error looks identical to a correct code.

name: ISRC year dropdown shows the raw 2-digit code, not the resolved 4-digit year
why: The design decision confirmed for org/ISRC.org item 4 — a 2-digit code is ambiguous over a century and less useful for filtering/sorting than the resolved year.

name: single-table runFilter() re-render skips the ISRC/ISWC reformat pass
why: Removing this call site is invisible to the fixture's own sort test — a known, honest gap, not a defect. `renderFinalTable()` MOVES rows rather than cloning them for `tableMode: 'single'` (artist-recordings), so once a cell is formatted the SAME live node is what a later sort reorders; there is nothing to re-derive. The call still matters for `tableMode: 'multi'` pages, where `renderGroupedTable()` clones fresh rows from `groupedRows` on every render — this spec has no multi-table fixture to see that half.

name: isIsrcCol column-name gate is wrong (never matches)
why: Without this gate the whole per-row scan block for the four constituent Maps and the validity counters never runs, so the 📊 dropdown offers no ISRC sections at all on any pageType — a silent, page-wide feature loss rather than a narrow bug.
